def get_type(N):
    win = [False] * (N + 1)
    win[N] = False
    for n in range(N - 1, 0, -1):
        can_move_to_lose = False
        if n + 1 <= N and not win[n + 1]:
            can_move_to_lose = True
        if 2 * n <= N and not win[2 * n]:
            can_move_to_lose = True
        win[n] = can_move_to_lose
    return 'B' if win[1] else 'A'
